{{Money|600}} (Group Bonus) |music-1 = '''Original Ambient'''[[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Skibidi|250px|center|thumb]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|The brain rot has begun!|'''Headache Headquarters''' being activated}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Headache Headquarters''' was a [[Maps|map]] set in a laboratory, only playable by sending "''dop dop yes yes''" in chat on Wave 0 during April Fools, after the mode/map vote but before the first wave starts. It has been made available through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, without the [[Brain Rot]] modifier being applied. Triumphing this map for the first time gave the {{Color|Premium|Toilet}} [[Scout]] skin, if the player did not have it already. Otherwise, the rewards were the same as [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode, but boosted by 50% (60% if the map originally chosen had [[All Paths]]). '''Headache Headquarters''' had the [[Brain Rot]] modifier, which replaced all enemies except the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]], [[Speedy Boss]], [[Enraged]] and [[Brute]]. Additionally, based on the map that was chosen in the beginning, it may have had additional modifiers, like the [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]] or [[All Paths]]. While they would not make the map harder, they would affect the appearance of enemies or increase the rewards. When opened in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, it has no modifiers. ==Design & Path== '''Headache Headquarters''' takes place in a laboratory. The room the map is located in has grey walls and floor. It is quite empty, only having a few grey crates and what appears to be multiple monitors close to each other. On the walls, multiple screens can be found. There are also a few windows and gates, through which various halls are visible. These halls have doors, vending machines and benches. Multiple grey metal pipes can also be found on the walls. The black path starts at the black door and ends at the white one. The path goes straight and then makes two loops, with a single straight path between them. After these two loops, the path goes straight again. ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Headache Headquarters}} ==Rewards== The game calculated how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you received based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 100% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned was multiplied by 2x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplied any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts were additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts were multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map. Any rewards that ended in a decimal point was rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. When activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, it gives no rewards. When activated in a real match, rewards were calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" ! colspan="2" |April Fools 2026 |- !Coins Reward !EXP Reward |- |({{Coins|200}} ÷ (1 + [(20 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|50}} (Triumph Only)) × 1.5 |({{Exp|50}} ÷ (1 + [(20 ÷ Current Wave) - 1])) × 1.5 |- ! colspan="2" |April Fools 2025 |- !Coins Reward !EXP Reward |- |({{Coins|250}} ÷ (1 + [(25 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|50}} (Triumph Only)) × 1.5 |({{Exp|50}} ÷ (1 + [(25 ÷ Current Wave) - 1])) × 1.5 |- ! colspan="2" |April Fools 2024 |- !Coins Reward !EXP Reward |- |({{Coins|200}} ÷ (1 + [(25 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|100}} (Triumph Only)) × 1.5 |({{Exp|50}} ÷ (1 + [(25 ÷ Current Wave) - 1])) × 1.5 |} Triumphing it for the first time in a real match also gave the {{Color|Premium|Toilet}} [[Scout]] skin. ===Badges=== There was also one [[badges|badge]] which can be obtained when playing on this map. It is: {{Badge |title = dop dop yes yes |description = skibidi |image = dop dop yes yes badge.png |obtainable = No }} ==Wave Structure== The wave structure was similar to [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode's but most enemies were replaced by their stronger variants because of the [[Brain Rot]] modifier. *The [[Toilet]] replaced the [[Normal]]. *The [[Streamer]] replaced the [[Speedy]]. *The [[Chad]] replaced the [[Slow]]. *The [[Metal Toilet]] replaced the [[Normal Boss]]. *The [[Ninja Toilet]] replaced the [[Hidden]]. *The [[Png Bot2]] replaced the [[Breaker2]]. **The [[Png Bot2]] also spawns [[Png Bot]] upon death. *The [[Brick Man]] replaced the [[Skeleton]]. *The [[Armored Toilet]] replaced the [[Armored]]. *The [[Megatron Toilet]] replaced the [[Slow Boss]]. *The [[Pro Streamer]] replaced the [[Hidden Boss]], though this cannot be seen due to the [[Hidden Boss]] being removed entirely from [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode. *The [[Arrow]] replaced the [[Bolt]], though this cannot be seen due to [[Enraged]] replacing the [[Bolt]]. *The [[Png Bot4]] replaced the [[Breaker4]], though this cannot be seen due to [[Breaker4]] being removed entirely from [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode. **The [[Png Bot4]] also spawned [[Png Bot3]] upon death. *The [[Toilet Boss]] replaced the [[Grave Digger]], though this cannot be seen due to [[Brute]] replacing the [[Grave Digger]]. The [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] also had its health increased to 1,200. The waves in '''Headache Headquarters''' followed these timings: {{Tabber |2026 |{{pe| {| class{{=}}"wikitable align-center" style{{=}}"width:50%; margin:0 auto" !Waves !Wave Timer !Skip TimeHow long you have to wait before you can skip. |- |1-15 |1:00 |0:19Skip at 0:40. |- |16-19 |1:30 |0:19Skip at 1:10. |- |20 |∞ |N/A |} }} |2024/2025 |{{pe| {| class{{=}}"wikitable align-center" style{{=}}"width:50%; margin:0 auto" !Waves !Wave Timer !Skip TimeHow long you have to wait before you can skip. |- |1-15 |1:00 |0:19 |- |16-24 |1:30 |0:19 |- |25 |∞ |N/A |} }} }} '''Bolded''' names indicate an enemy type's debut.

==Strategy== *The [[Ace Pilot]] can be useful here, as this map has two loops which are ideal for its circling range. *As the paths are quite close to each other, high range towers like the [[Turret]], [[Mortar]] or [[Ranger]] can easily cover most or all of the path on this map. *While this map has quite a lot of cliffs, most of it far away from the path, while the ones close to it are limited, making cliff towers less useful here. **The [[Ranger]], because of its high range, can actually reach all the paths on most spots, making it still useful. ===Original Strategy=== This section contains strategy for '''Headache Headquarters''' in its [[Aprilini Foolsini Eventini]] state. While it could still be used if the player attempts to recreate it by applying the [[Brain Rot]] modifier and starting an [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode match, due to changes with the game this may not be perfectly accurate. *You can earn extra money before the mode starts by placing a [[Farm]] and upgrading it before saying "''dop dop yes yes''". You will be awarded the cash spent on the [[Farm]] and the extra amount it generated, allowing the purchase of upgrades or towers that you could not normally afford on the first wave. *It is recommended to select a map with the [[All Paths]] modifier, like [[Infernal Abyss]] or [[Winter Stronghold]], as modifiers are carried over from previous map to '''Headache Headquarters'''. While this does not make the match harder, since the map only has one path, it will increase the rewards gotten at the end of the match. *Early-game towers with decent DPS, like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Electroshocker]], [[Golden Cowboy]] or [[Militant]] can be very effective here. *High DPS towers like the the [[Accelerator]] or [[Minigunner]] are recommended though it may be hard to afford them due to how little cash the enemies give, especially in higher player counts. *The [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Pursuit]] can be useful here, as this map has two loops which are ideal for their circling range. *The [[Medic]] can be useful at shielding towers from stuns while providing minor buffs. *The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] are highly recommended on this map. **The [[Commander]] can be useful at boosting your tower's firerate, giving them more DPS and making dealing with the much stronger enemies easier. **The [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at increasing the range of your towers, in some cases allowing them to cover most of the map, while also decreasing their upgrade costs. ==Trivia== *'''Headache Headquarters''' was based on the Skibidi Bunker, which originates from episodes 67-70 of ''Skibidi Toilet''. *When going out of bounds using free cam, an image of the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/prowler-theme-goku-prowler-xenoverse-2 Prowler Goku] meme could be found. ==Update History== *'''1 April 2024''' -
